decision: The main agent confirmed aligned baseline reruns as the final logical Cases 1 to 3. Original baseline runs remain prealignment archives and are excluded from final five-case comparison.

case04.role: formal enhanced k-epsilon EWT with strict convergence verification

case05.role: formal enhanced RSM EWT continued from strictly verified Case4 with prescribed relaxation

comparison_policy: The initial enhanced RSM attempt is not Case 4. Missing aligned or verified datasets stay unavailable; no fallback to prealignment or early-threshold datasets is permitted. Final verification normally uses residual criteria at most 1e-5 and both force ranges/absolute means at most 0.1% over the last 100 updates. An independently qualified residual-floor exception requires an explicit native-source-hash-bound review record; its strict numerical gate remains false and its limitation must be reported.
